tools.description: List places (rooms, workspaces, roomLists, buildings, desks, etc.) of a specific type defined in the tenant. Returns a collection of place objects. Pass placeType as an OData type literal (e.g. 'microsoft.graph.room', 'microsoft.graph.roomList', 'microsoft.graph.building', 'microsoft.graph.desk').
tools.llmTip: $filter and $count are ONLY supported when placeType is microsoft.graph.room, microsoft.graph.workspace, or microsoft.graph.roomList — Graph returns 400 for other place types. Default page size is 100 for room/workspace/roomList and 1000 for other types; pass $top to override. Personal Microsoft accounts are not supported — this tool requires a work/school account (--org-mode).
